profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer passionate about automation with intuitive user experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Substrate
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Building AI-powered platforms and internal tools. 

Tech: Python • React • TypeScript • Ruby • Kotlin • MySQL • Redis • AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
From concept to production, our team built Loom - a custom and innovative cloud based computer aided design software that will assist computation biologist in designing combinatorial libraries of DNA. Additionally we built Orderly - a microservice automating the process of ordering DNA sequences as well as automating the receiving of DNA sequences into our lab space from various vendors. Technologies include Postgres, MySQL, Python / Django / Flask, Javascript / React, testing frameworks such as Cypress, and AWS Lambda / SQS for scaling.

To aid in the fight against COVID-19, our team has rapidly built custom in house Sample Tracking Software to help our biologist and operators screen customer samples for Coronavirus. Check out https://www.ginkgobioworks.com/2020/06/18/announcing-concentric-by-ginkgo-covid-19-testing-at-scale/ to learn more about what Ginkgo is doing to fight COVID-19.

positions.title: Mobile Development Consultant
positions.description: Worked with CEO and Graphic Designer to create a React Native mobile application compatible with iOS and Andriod. The mobile application was an e-commerce application for a desktop 3D printer.

positions.title: General Assembly Software Engineering Immersion Program
positions.description:
As a Computer Science teacher with a love for learning, I taught myself how to code through online resources. Becoming passionate about the logic problems of code, I co-led Robotics and founded Girls Who Code at my school. Although I love developing curiosity in others, I quickly realized that my true passion was in coding. In July 2018, I took the leap of faith to switch careers and attend General Assembly. 

I designed and built full-stack web applications using the latest front- and back-end languages, frameworks, tools, and methodologies including: HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Javascript, ReactJS, jQuery, AJAX, Handlebars, PostgreSQL, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Git / Github. Implemented RESTful routes.

Each project was built in 5 days. Projects can be viewed on my github at https://github.com/jenfox4/

Technology highlights for projects include: 
- Capstone Project (Summit): Web scraping, Ruby / Ruby on Rails, ReactJS, JavaScript, HTML/Css, Material-UI, Third Party API (Dark Sky), Chartjs 
- Tic Tac Toe Game: Artifical intelligence, JavaScript, HTML/Css, bootstrap 
- GRE Flashcard App: JavaScript, HTML/Css, Bootstrap, Ruby / Ruby on Rails, Test driven development, PostgreSQL / SQL (Relational Databases)
- Survey App (Group Project): JavaScript,  HTML/Css, ExpressJS, MongoDB (Non-relational database)

positions.title: Math, Science, and Computer Science Teacher
positions.description: Passionate about bringing computer science to young students, I assisted in shaping the computer science curriculum for k-8. Additionally, I founded and lead the Girls Who Code club where I designed a rigorous curriculum for girls in 6th-8th grade to explore computer science concepts. Through a variety of projects, students explored physical computation, basic coding principles and logic, and web development principles using HTML and CSS. I also co-lead the Robotics team where students used Lego Mindstorms to learn about coding and robotics principles.

positions.title: Math and Science teacher
positions.description: As a Teach For America corps member, I had the opportunity to teach for two years on the West side of Chicago. During this time I not only gained invaluable leadership and organizational skills that carry with me today, but I was able to explore what education meant to me. I have a long-lasting love for learning and an insatiable sense of curiosity. I realized that I loved bringing the joy of learning and questioning to others through my love of STEM subjects. In addition to the personal growth I gained, I gained insights into the education industry within America. I am passionate about educational justice and tackling educational inequity, especially within the STEM subjects for underrepresented communities.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Participant Recruitment Co-coordinator
positions.description:
Responsibilities include recruiting participants for various studies, consenting and running participants, analyzing data, and assisting in the publication of papers. 
Supervisor: Kenneth Levy, PhD

company.name: Laboratory for Personality, Psychopathology, and Psychotherapy Research

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Bio-behavioral Health Department, Pennsylvania State University
positions.description:
Research in this lab focuses on how personality relates to physiology and 
health. 
 Responsibilities include working with rodents in a research setting including 
rodent breeding, rodent experiments, rodent behavioral testing, necropsies, and 
PCR techniques to examine RNA and DNA markers of behavior. Rodent 
experimentation includes collecting blood samples, utilizing whole body 
plethysmographs, and female rodent smearing. Rodent behavioral testing 
includes elevated plus maze, forced swim test, open field test, light dark box 
test, and sucrose preference test.

positions.title: Associate Editor of Psychology and Social Sciences
positions.description: Responsibilities include editing undergraduate manuscripts with the assistant of a faculty member for publication in monthly issues. Supervisor: William Ray, PhD

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Walter Reed Army Medical Center, Department of Vascular Surgery and Radiology
positions.description:
Responsibilities included working on two projects; creating a teaching and research database comparing CT, MR and catheter arteriography images in Microsoft Access, and creating an interdisciplinary brochure for a combined Vascular Surgery-Radiology clinical service. 
Supervisor: Irwin Feuerstein, M.D.
